body: When I choose our saved mapping under Contacts > Import, I get: We couldn't load this import mapping. Ask an admin to duplicate the mapping and try again. (MAP-403)
Was the mapping originally created by a member who is now deactivated? Please do not reactivate anyone while I check the supported path.
Yes. The original owner left our company last month. A new import without the saved mapping opens normally.
Matched BUG-2841. Guided an active Workspace Admin through Settings > Data management > Import mappings, filtered deactivated owners, duplicated the mapping, and assigned the copy to the admin.
Confirmed: the duplicate loaded, Import started appeared, and Activity > Imports now shows Completed with the expected contact count.

A new contact import shows: Some columns could not be matched. Review your headers and try again. (CSV-102)
This is a column validation error, not the saved-mapping access issue.
The file has two columns both named Company.
Confirmed duplicate headers; BUG-2841 does not apply.
Renaming the second header fixed the import.
